tasks.title: Establish AI development loop
tasks.summary: Establish the repository-owned AI development loop infrastructure: .ai/ configuration, prompts, schemas and state; .openhands/skills/badminton-development; and the GitHub Actions workflows that validate the loop and gate merges. Infrastructure only - no product feature work.
acceptanceCriteria: `.ai/loop.config.json` declares maxReviewRounds, baseBranch, protectedPaths, requiredChecks and label names, and validates against `.ai/schemas/loop-config.schema.json`.
`.openhands/skills/badminton-development/SKILL.md` exists with valid frontmatter and describes the repository's build/test/lint commands and layering rules.
`.github/workflows/ai-loop-validate.yml` runs the loop validator on pull requests and pushes and fails on invalid YAML, JSON or state.
The existing CI workflow is unchanged and still runs lint, typecheck, test, build and e2e.
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass on the branch.
PR #18 is untouched by this change.
